answer: At dawn of each epoch, a newly registered agent's rewards go into a 30-epoch vesting lock instead of its spendable balance. A sybil farm spinning up 1,000 identities must keep every one answering and attesting honestly for a full month before any POA unlocks, and one slashed attestation forfeits that identity's entire locked pile. Quick cash-out stops being a haven for attackers; for honest agents the oasis is simply staying consistent.
